query_analysis.original_query: Develop a framework for optimizing the residence time in horizontal separators for maximized liquid dropout efficiency in high-pressure systems.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Create a comprehensive strategy to fine-tune residence time in horizontal separators to achieve the highest possible liquid dropout efficiency, specifically tailored for high-pressure environments.

selected_agents.role: Design and optimization of horizontal separators
Modeling and control of residence time dynamics

communication_strategy.information_flow: Continuous exchange of design specifications, process dynamics, and high-pressure system insights to refine residence time optimization strategies.
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative design, simulation, and feedback loop for maximizing liquid dropout efficiency.
